{"notes": "Visit 1 (left at 1:00). Only saw/heard Sofia and Hana; nothing yet on Omar or Jack, so no rating evidence for them. I won't guess.

Sofia: Said she's adopting Hana's numbers and is laying stroke 1 from the nose. Proactively flagged that the notch where back meets tail turns sharply and proposed checking it once up and softening if it stalls. Good foresight and clear communication. I didn't see her place dominoes, so I can't credit specific pieces to her.

Hana: Appears to have set the plan (numbers, fish drawing on the pad). Told Sofia no redraw was needed and to continue stroke 1. Said she'd start the top tail once Sofia's line reaches it, and agreed to check the notch. Shows coordination, sequencing and some leadership. Her instruction was clear and kept things moving. Need to see whether the plan holds up and whether she shares the load.

Table state: Everything laid is connected to the start, with a long upper arc reaching about x=10, y=5.6 and a shorter lower branch to about x=6, y=12.7. There are no pale/disconnected pieces yet. The junction near the start (about x=3.5, y=10) is the sharp spot to watch. I can't tell who built which part.

To do next visit: observe Omar and Jack directly, check the notch and whether it was softened, and see whether the handoff to the tail worked."}
